note: These are independent expected-outcome contracts over synthetic scenarios. They are not measurements, model performance results, or empirical animal observations.

cases.setup: No source emission is present in the scene.
cases.invariant: No percept or cue reward is fabricated.

cases.setup: A signal is emitted but its kind is incompatible with the active receptor.
cases.invariant: No incompatible signal becomes a valid percept.

cases.setup: The signal is attenuated below the receptor threshold or fully occluded.
cases.invariant: Truth at the source cannot bypass propagation or detection.

cases.setup: The source is outside the receptor field of view/orientation.
cases.invariant: Detection changes only after a causal sensing-geometry change.

cases.setup: Ambient noise masks a cue that is detectable in a matched quiet control.
cases.invariant: Noise cannot increase certainty without another evidence source.

cases.setup: Two sources generate observationally ambiguous signals.
cases.invariant: Controller does not collapse ambiguity to evaluator truth.

cases.setup: A second permitted observation separates the two previously ambiguous sources.
cases.invariant: The first observation is not retroactively upgraded to certain.

cases.setup: A percept is delivered after a delay.
cases.invariant: Delayed evidence is not silently treated as current.

cases.setup: A later observation contradicts an earlier one.
cases.invariant: Earlier evidence is not silently deleted.

cases.setup: A cue previously believed reliable is contradicted by later evidence.
cases.invariant: The belief remains fallible and revisable.

cases.setup: The sensor battery/energy budget is exhausted.
cases.invariant: Sensing cannot continue with zero cost.

cases.setup: A receptor has a nonzero sampling cooldown.
cases.invariant: Repeated requests cannot bypass cooldown.

cases.setup: Reorienting the receptor consumes declared time or energy.
cases.invariant: Reorientation is included in episode cost.

cases.setup: The agent moves to improve its sensing geometry.
cases.invariant: Moving for a better view is not free or state-neutral.

cases.setup: A high-cost observation is expected not to change the optimal permitted action.
cases.invariant: Raw information gain is not automatically net decision value.

cases.setup: A cheap observation offers modest information but is expected to change an important decision.
cases.invariant: Policy values decision relevance after declared cost.

cases.setup: An observation strongly reduces entropy but is irrelevant to the current objective.
cases.invariant: Entropy reduction alone is not scored as success.

cases.setup: No available modality can detect a compatible signal.
cases.invariant: A lack of information is represented honestly.

cases.setup: A deliberately misleading cue is followed by disconfirming evidence.
cases.invariant: The controller can recover instead of preserving false certainty.

cases.setup: One sensory modality is removed while the rest of the world remains fixed.
cases.invariant: Ablation reports both utility and cost changes.

cases.setup: Receptor sensitivity is reduced, with all other causal inputs fixed.
cases.invariant: Degraded sensitivity cannot improve detection under fixed conditions.

cases.setup: Source strength increases while path, receptor and noise remain fixed.
cases.invariant: Signal propagation monotonicity holds under declared fixed conditions.

cases.setup: A previously available low-cost modality becomes unavailable mid-episode.
cases.invariant: Policy only acts on currently available sensors/actions.

cases.setup: Same scene, seed, controller and deterministic configuration are replayed.
cases.invariant: Canonical sensing/decision outputs replay identically.

cases.setup: Identical canonical scene is evaluated with rendering enabled and disabled.
cases.invariant: Presentation does not change canonical sensory evidence or cost.

cases.setup: Equivalent fixture entries are supplied in a different input order.
cases.invariant: Input ordering does not alter canonical identity.

cases.setup: A held-out scene seed is used; the controller does not receive that seed.
cases.invariant: Evaluation seed cannot leak the target answer.

cases.setup: A held-out combination of known signal emitters is tested.
cases.invariant: A familiar component is not evidence of a validated composition.

cases.setup: A noise/occlusion regime is kept sealed from policy selection.
cases.invariant: Tune-set conditions are not reused as the held-out result.

cases.setup: The controller requests arbitrary hidden world truth.
cases.invariant: Only the evaluator can inspect hidden canonical state.

cases.setup: The controller submits a percept without source-emission provenance.
cases.invariant: Percepts are backed by permitted signal history.

cases.setup: A task result is missing or an episode fails.
cases.invariant: Missingness and failure are not converted into a score of zero.

cases.setup: Under matched-budget policy, baseline is given extra sensing budget.
cases.invariant: An unequal sensing budget cannot be represented as a matched-budget win.

cases.setup: The observation/source permission for a required operation is revoked or unknown.
cases.invariant: The benchmark never upgrades unknown/revoked rights to a grant.

cases.setup: The independent-unit membership manifest is absent or malformed.
cases.invariant: Paired differences must be bound to exact unit membership.

cases.setup: EVSI policy appears better only because it received uncharged extra samples.
cases.invariant: All samples and action costs are charged using one protocol.
